title: Largest transaction per customer
statementMd:
For each customer, find the transaction with the largest absolute amount (customer name, transaction id, amount). Ties go to the lowest id.

Expected columns: `name`, `transaction_id`, `amount`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT a.customer_id, t.id, t.amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY ABS(t.amount) DESC, t.id) AS rn FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id) SELECT c.name, r.id AS transaction_id, r.amount FROM r JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
